reviews.t: Too sharp for the scalp
reviews.x: These wooden combs are supposed to be better than the plastic ones. But I had to scrape and see if this was real wood and it is wood. The reason I am not too happy about this product is because the teeth are very sharp and hurt the scalp. I am not too fond of these. I do not know if all the combs are sharp like these or this batch alone. I received four in the package and all are extremely sharp.

reviews.t: I love that there's no static cling and my hair seems ...
reviews.x: I wish I had discovered wooden combs years ago!  I love that there's no static cling and my hair seems to really respond to these wooden combs.  These combs are extremely well made and light enough to carry around in my purse without weighing it down too much.  I will have to order more soon as my mom and son keep confiscating my combs!

reviews.t: I will not recommend this product
reviews.x: I took sometime to post review on this product. Quality is not as expected. I have straight silky textured, low volume hair, and I used this handled comb for nearly 2 weeks and now for reason it broke into 2 pieces. Attached the image, I will not recommend this product.

reviews.t: Nice combs...
reviews.x: I got these at the same time that I got the comb made from natural horn and it quickly became my favorite, but these are nice combs if you're looking for smaller combs. I would recommend them, for sure.

reviews.t: One of the combs snapped in half after using it ...
reviews.x: One of the combs snapped in half after using it for about a week. I'm hoping the others last longer.

reviews.t: Something for everyone in the family
reviews.x: I could have easily used the smaller combs in my smallish adult hand, wrapping two fingers around the grip and laying the index along the spine. But this was a family purchase. I, with fine curly hair, selected the larger fine-toothed comb; my son with fine, straight hair, the smaller fine-toothed. Our ladies with longer hair got the large-toothed combs. With my son, I noticed the absence of static immediately, as his cowlick is indicative. On my scalp, this helps me exfoliate without scratching

reviews.t: Great combs, great value!
reviews.x: Update: One year later: Most of my combs have cracked after daily use. However, I'm going to reorder. This is still the most sustainably-sourced material I can think of for a comb. This time, I'm going to oil them more frequently. I wasn't bothered by water spots, so I hadn't been doing it, but I think it will keep them from becoming brittle and may make them last longer. reviews.t: GREAT COMBS!!!!!
reviews.x: VERY,VERY NICE COMBS! I WOULD SAY THAT THERE BEST FOR LONG HAIR. IVE HAD MY DAUGHTERS TRY THEM AND THERE WAS ACTUALLY NO WHINING!!(thank god).THEY ARE WELL BUILT. I MIGHT TRY AND PUT A ("wood protectant,or some lemon oil)OIL ON THE WOOD. THEY DO SEEM VERY DRY. SO IF YOU PUT LEMON OIL ON THEM THEY WOULD PROABLY LAST ALOT LONGER. AND PROABLY LESS OF A CHANCE OF THEM BREAKING. DEFFINATLY WOULD BUY AGAIN. CANT BEAT GETTING 4 BAMBOO(i think) COMBS FOR SUCH A CHEAP PRICE.

reviews.t: These are good combs. I like that there are 2 different ...
reviews.x: These are good combs. I like that there are 2 different teeth sets wide and fine. I use these daily on both my hair and my beard. They do seem really really dry, but maybe that's my Colorado weather (very dry here).  I might add oil to them, as time goes by, but for now they are doing very well.

reviews.x: I read a lot about hair, energy and how to treat one's hair naturally to serve its natural purpose. When I first used the wooden comb I immediately noticed my hair reacted differently. I assume due to lack of static electricity. Anyway, I'll use wooden combs from now on.

Overall these are very clean combs that are sturdy and do not build up static electricity into your hair. I think this is one of my new favorites for the kids. He uses the fine-toothed combs for his beard and I use the other ones for my hair (natural/kinky textured). reviews.t: I like this comb.
reviews.x: I wanted only one wooden comb, but the one I liked best came in a pack of four, so I've used only one.  There are only 4 stars because I can't comment on the other three combs.  The comb been fine on my hair and does what I wanted, which was to avoid creating static electricity.  It is solid, not joined pieces, so it is sturdy. reviews.t: 2 out of 4 ain't bad.
reviews.x: These are cool, feel great, and look great. The moist ache combs have a fatal flaw, however. The first time you drop them on a tile bathroom floor, they will break in half. Storing them in your gym bag yields the same result. The handled combs do not have the same issues. Great price for two still functioning combs.

reviews.t: Dropped one of the combs from the bathroom sink and ...

Make sense considering that it's wood but wasn't expecting that. Which is why they give you 4 due to their low durablability

reviews.t: These four combs feel very nice in my hand and very good on my scalp
reviews.x: These four combs feel very nice in my hand and very good on my scalp.  Having a natural product for grooming is good.  The combination of wide and narrow toothed combs is useful for de-tangling or just combing out the natural oils through my long hair.  Happy I bought these and use them daily.

reviews.t: Good but missed shape when getting wet
reviews.x: I've been using wood combs + brushes for the past 15 yrs. Never seen the wood comb shrink /missed shape when got wet before. One of the comb got few water drop on it, it turned curvy and missed shape. So we keep another 3 in the dry place. Didn't want to get another experiment

reviews.t: These combs are well made and good sized, but honestly I don't see what all ...
reviews.x: These combs are well made and good sized, but honestly I don't see what all the hype is about wood combs that I read in reviews.  To me there isn't any difference and was money not needed to spend, as my plastic detangling combs I'd rather use.

claims.text: Several reviewers report the combs breaking or snapping after short use, including within days or a week.
Many reviewers praise the combs for reducing static and working well on hair and beards.
Some reviewers find the combs too sharp on the scalp or too large in size.
Multiple reviewers note the wood feels very dry and suggest applying oil to it.
Reviewers describe the combs as well made and good quality, with some recommending them.
